challenge.better_approach: A hidden .lnk shortcut was considered and refused: a shortcut offers only Normal, Minimized or Maximized, and Minimized still flashes a taskbar button. wscript plus a VBS is a fallback, since VBScript is being phased out of Windows 11. The helper already holds the flags, so the smaller path is to extend its scan and give it a launcher.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That most windows come from Cairn spawn sites. A window can also come from the harness's shell spawner, from a scheduled task or startup entry running cairn.cmd, or from a grandchild spawned by bash. Some of the 46 files may be interactive on purpose. None of this is measured yet, which is why the falsifier names a window count.
challenge.prior_art: cairn/tools/windowless_spawn (ticket bce45318b2e0 and its charter: detached_kwargs, windowless_kwargs, background_pythonw, unhelped_sites). Measured 2026-11-20: unhelped_sites('.') returns 0 while 46 of 57 non-proof files that call subprocess.run/call/check_output do not mention either helper keyword set. The congruency lab holds no second intention for hiding windows.
challenge.real_collision: None found. Rule 1 (encapsulation) means the sweep cannot be one ticket editing 46 files in other components; each owning component carries its own child. Law 9 holds: the widened scan reds the sites it names, which is the measure.

answers.falsifier: Done when the widened scan names zero unhelped spawn sites over cairn/, bin/ and skills/, and a measured run of the ground loop and bus for several minutes on akiendell shows no console window created by a Cairn spawn. Wrong if the windows come from the harness's own shell spawner, outside any Cairn code.
answers.from_idea: none, because the idea was spoken in this session and the measured gap sits at cairn/tools/windowless_spawn/windowless_spawn.py unhelped_sites
answers.how: Widen windowless_spawn.unhelped_sites from 'Popen(' to every subprocess run/call/check_call/check_output site, so the scan names each spawn that does not take its flags from the helper (the sweep rides child tickets, one per owning component); and add a pythonw launcher in windowless_spawn that runs a command line with CREATE_NO_WINDOW, its output to a log and its exit code returned, for anything not meant to have a terminal.
answers.traces_to: CP4 (the terminal goal: the system serves the person using the box) and Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics: the existing proof greps only Popen, so a bare subprocess.run walks past it). Akien 2026-11-20: popups while he works on the same box are annoying and can interrupt typing; with them gone the only remaining cost is CPU, answered by pausing the box's work while he is present.
answers.what: No Cairn spawn on Windows opens a visible console window, so working on the same box is never interrupted by a popup.

bullets.text: unhelped_sites sees only Popen sites: it returns 0 over the tree while 46 of 57 non-proof files calling subprocess.run/call/check_output carry no helper keywords (measured 2026-11-20).

A fully hidden parent (no console) makes every console child open its own window; the safe shape is a GUI-subsystem launcher that owns one invisible console (CREATE_NO_WINDOW) which its descendants inherit.
Scheduled tasks and startup entries that run cairn.cmd still show a console; routing them through the launcher is a host-seam and is not in this ticket.

title: No Cairn spawn on Windows opens a visible console window, so working on the same box is never interrupted by a popup.
